_doc: Grudges and gratitude (RIV-001, Karma system). acts: hostile acts the player can commit against an NPC. Per act: name, days (time taken), fight (the NPC must be beaten first), requires_stronger (your realm must be above theirs), alignment (shift when done), grudge (added to the victim's grudge), kin_grudge (added for each living parent, child and spouse of the victim), failed_grudge (victim's grudge if you attack and lose), favor (victim's favor change), kills (the victim dies), sentence (optional, must contain {name}; {stones} becomes N spirit stone(s), from the act result; unknown acts use a generic line), loot_stones [min, max] spirit stones per (victim realm index + 1) plus everything they carry. max_grudge / max_gratitude cap the ledgers. decay_per_year: grudges fade by this much each year (gratitude does not). amends: stones_per_point (spirit stones per grudge point to make amends), min_cost. grudge_words: [[min_points, word], ...] in ascending order, naming a grudge value in messages (Karma.grudge_word). attitudes: {grudge, gratitude} each a list of [min_points, sentence] in ascending order; an NPC's Look text adds the sentence of the highest threshold their ledger value reaches ({name} = the NPC's name). Grudges are never held against the player by their own family, and children (younger than family.json adult_age) cannot be targeted. gratitude (RIV-001e): sources {kind: points} of gratitude earned per kind act (treat_npc: healing their injury, gift: giving them an item); favor_bonus_per_point: a grateful NPC's chat/gift favor gain is raised by gain x gratitude x this (still capped by family.json acquaintance limits); repay: each month an NPC owing at least min_gratitude has chance_per_month to send spirit stones (stones_per_realm [min, max] x their realm index + 1) plus one weighted gift ({weight, effects}, shared Effects keys, {} = stones only), spending cost gratitude. hunt (RIV-003): after each journey the living NPC with the strongest grudge of at least min_grudge may ambush the player on the road with chance grudge x chance_per_point (capped at max_chance), times weaker_scale per major realm they are below the player; beating them changes their grudge by beaten_grudge, losing to them (never lethal; they take stones) by victory_grudge. aid: when ambushed, the NPC with the most gratitude (at least min_gratitude) comes to help with `chance`, spending gratitude_cost gratitude and granting `buff` (a buffs.gd buff) for the fight. rival (RIV-002, Rivals): a generated NPC of the player's age, realm and stage spawned in the start region when a game starts (older saves gain one on load): diligence (fraction of days cultivating; generated NPCs roll 0.15-0.6), root_purity [min, max] (purity of the single spiritual root it gets), proud (refuses to be a concubine). Encounters can target the rival (see encounters.json `rival`). ally_strike (RIV-001f, under gratitude): when the player starts a fight (not a sparring match), the most grateful living adult NPC who lives in the current region and owes at least min_gratitude joins with an opening strike of `blows` times their own attack, spending cost gratitude (so each debt pays out once or twice). Encounter choices may name a new NPC who owes the player (encounters.json grateful_npc).

grudge: {name} has sworn to see you dead.
gratitude: {name} owes you a debt of life.
